name: claude-engineer
test_cmd: mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" && HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 $PY -c "import glob; [compile(open(p).read(), p, \"exec\") for g in (\"*.py\", \"tools/*.py\", \"prompts/*.py\", \"Claude-Eng-v2/*.py\") for p in sorted(glob.glob(g))]; import ce3, importlib, pkgutil, tools; [importlib.import_module(\"tools.\" + m.name) for m in pkgutil.iter_modules(tools.__path__)]" && HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 $PY -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -o addopts= test.py
notes: No CI config (no .github/) and no tests/ dir, although pyproject's pytest config points testpaths at tests/ and addopts at --cov=cev3 (a package that does not exist). The repo's only test file is root test.py (9 unittest cases for calculate_sum/calculate_median, unrelated to the LLM code), so test_cmd runs `pytest -o addopts= test.py` (addopts cleared to drop the pytest-cov/cev3 options). Because test.py never touches the Anthropic call sites, test_cmd first runs a guard step that must pass before pytest runs: compile() every tracked .py (root, tools/, prompts/, Claude-Eng-v2/; compile only, so the v2 deps ollama/tavily/websockets/speech_recognition are not needed) and import ce3 plus every tools.* module (incl. tools.toolcreator). A migration that breaks syntax or imports in ce3.py/config.py/tools/ makes test_cmd exit non-zero. Importing does not instantiate Assistant, so no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is needed; app.py is compiled but not imported (it builds Assistant() at import, which needs a key). PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 keeps __pycache__ out of the repo copy. No editable install: pyproject's hatch version.path (cev3/__init__.py) and uv workspace member (testfolder) don't exist, so `-e $SRC` / `uv sync` can't build; the code is flat top-level modules imported from cwd, so no reinstall step is needed. Deps: requirements.txt (the Flask/CLI app's) + e2b-code-interpreter (in pyproject deps, imported by tools/e2bcodetool.py) + pytest. Python 3.11.17 (requires-python >=3.9, classifiers to 3.11). Resolved anthropic==1.13.0, flask==3.0.0, e2b-code-interpreter==2.10.5, pytest==9.1.1. Baseline taken with outbound network denied (macOS sandbox-exec, loopback allowed) and RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset; two runs gave identical counts (9 passed; 2.9s and 2.2s wall incl. imports). Rebuilt from scratch into a second env: identical uv pip freeze and identical counts. Nothing deselected.
